knownLimitations.description: C2A normalized signal boundaries are controlled software calibration, not universal geophysical constants or observationally calibrated probabilities.
Radial compact-support fields do not independently reconstruct oriented margins, ridges, arcs, trenches, sutures, transforms, or spreading direction.
Shelf and slope remain RESEARCH_REQUIRED and require mixed crustal provenance plus later material, sedimentary, sea-level, bathymetric, and surface-gradient evidence.
Drowned continental affinity remains an alternative until later material, buoyancy, exposure, and surface context exists.
C2B interprets caller-supplied spherical regions; Phase C does not claim a final global structural partition, coastline, or physical region geometry.
The completion gate does not establish generated-world role frequencies, global accuracy, or observational calibration.
